description: This file appears to be a Makefile segment used for configuring, preparing, compiling, and handling Linux kernel builds within an OpenWrt project. It contains definitions for setting up kernel sources, creating initramfs images, and various build directives.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the Linux kernel with default settings, copying configuration files, and preparing the build environment.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules/Default
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules and prepares the kernel image.

methods.name: Kernel/SetInitramfs
methods.description: Sets up the initial ram filesystem (initramfs) with specific configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/SetNoInitramfs
methods.description: Removes or disables the initramfs configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure/Initramfs
methods.description: Configures the kernel to include initramfs.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Default
methods.description: Compiles the kernel image and copies it to the target directory.

methods.name: Kernel/PrepareConfigPerRootfs
methods.description: Prepares separate kernel configuration directories for different root filesystem images.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage/Initramfs
